A LITTLE MORE ABOUT THE PERSON

Student by degree.
Developer by practice.

Full-stack developer at Xpert Safety Solutions, final-year B.Tech CSE, with roughly two years of real production work behind me.

I’m Navneet Srivastav, a full-stack developer who takes ideas from a requirement all the way to a live product.

I work at Xpert Safety Solutions Pvt. Ltd., where I build and maintain web and mobile software: corporate websites, management systems, admin dashboards, authentication flows and API-driven apps. Alongside that, I’m in the final year of my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering.

In about two years I’ve taken 5–6+ projects live. I work across React, Next.js and TypeScript on the front, Laravel and PHP on the back, MySQL and SQL Server for data, and Flutter for mobile.

I don’t hand things over half-finished. Requirement, UI, API, database, authentication, testing, debugging, deployment: I’m comfortable owning the whole chain.

A FEW THINGS I BELIEVE

Good software starts
with good habits.

01

Ship it for real.

Code on my laptop proves nothing. I care about what happens after deployment: stability, speed and whether people can use it.

02

Own the whole chain.

UI, API, database and auth are one product. Knowing all of them makes each one better.

03

Debug calmly.

Port conflicts, version mismatches, broken auth flows: every bug has a cause. Stay methodical and find it.
